out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reported: 'No. I lost awareness of my body' (no explicit OBE separation sensations described).

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A 'black doorway' like a small foyer with depth; 'not quite a tunnel' but a short pathway/void leading toward light and to another side.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'tremendous number of people gathering, socializing, and being together' (no known relationship). Also an unidentifiable questioning 'voice' experienced telepathically.

environment.environment_other_detail: Paved road; fields of wildflowers on both sides; mountains in the distance; a wall close to one side that could be touched; a black doorway/foyer-like void with light beyond; later many people gathered on the far side.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He turned back from the populated area, went back through the black void/doorway, continued down the road; later woke in the hospital (timeline unclear).
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He reported saying he had 'things I still had to do,' including something important that would positively impact many people; later: 'That I am here to help many people' (unsure if through him or his child).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pneumococcal meningitis; found unresponsive; later 'bagged' for breathing support; medicated coma for five weeks; hospital stay ~2.5 to 3 months.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: He described his background as 'Agnostic theism' (belief in at least one supreme being; many messengers).
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Agnostic theism; not a churchgoer; does not believe in typical organized religion.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Telepathic Q&A in a white room/void; walking down a road; doorway/foyer-like void; large crowd of people; he chose to turn back.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE; begins with white room/void telepathic questioning, then road/fields, then doorway/short void toward light into a populated area, then self-initiated return and later awakening in hospital (timeline unclear).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A mirrored landscape with a touchable wall on one side and endless wildflower fields on the other; a 'black doorway' described as a small foyer with depth (not a typical tunnel); telepathic interview-like questioning in a white room/void; he intentionally turned around because he was 'not ready.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I did not want to go yet because there were things I still had to do.” / “I asked for the opportunity to at least come back long enough to tell my mom where my money and things of mine were located.” / “This is a cool place, but I’m not ready to be here yet.” / “I am here to bless all of them with love.” / “To this day I have no fear of dying.” / “We are going to be ok.”
